tool.name: impg similarity
tool.description: pairwise similarity between sequences in a region
tool.command: @SETUP_ALIGNMENTS@ @SETUP_SEQUENCE_FILES@ impg similarity @ALIGNMENT_ARGS@ #if str($query_region.mode) == "single" -r '$query_region.target_range' #else -b '$query_region.target_bed' #end if @CMD_MERGE_DISTANCE@ @SEQUENCE_FILE_ARGS@ --gfa-engine poa $distances $all #if str($grouping.delim).strip() --delim '$grouping.delim' --delim-pos $grouping.delim_pos #end if #if $pca_options.pca --pca --pca-components $pca_options.pca_components --pca-measure $pca_options.pca_measure --polarize-n-prev $pca_options.polarize_n_prev #if str($pca_options.polarize_guide_samples).strip() --polarize-guide-samples '$pca_options.polarize_guide_samples' #end if #end if @CMD_TRANSITIVE@ @CMD_INDEX_OPTS@ #if str($coords.original_sequence_coordinates) == "true" --original-sequence-coordinates #end if @THREADS@ > '$output'

param.name: sequence_files
param.label: Sequence files
param.help: Source FASTA(s) for the sequences in the alignment. Required.

param.label: Emit all pairs
param.help: Emit entries for all pairs of groups, including those with zero intersection.

param.label: Group delimiter
param.help: The part of each path name before this delimiter is a group identifier (e.g. '#' for PanSN). Leave blank to treat each sequence as its own group.

validator.message: A single delimiter character or empty

param.label: Delimiter position
param.help: Consider the N-th occurrence of the delimiter (1-indexed).

param.label: Perform PCA/MDS
param.help: Run dimensionality reduction on the distance matrix and emit PC coordinates per group.

param.label: Polarize N previous regions
param.help: Number of previous regions to use for adaptive polarization (0 to disable).

param.label: Polarize guide samples
param.help: Comma-separated sample names to use for adaptive polarization.

tool.help:
**impg similarity** — pairwise similarity within a region
Computes pairwise similarity (Jaccard, cosine, Dice) and an estimated identity between the homologous sequences gathered for a target region, using the implicit alignment graph. Optionally emits distances, groups sequences by a name delimiter (e.g. PanSN `#`), and runs PCA/MDS on the distance matrix.
-----
**Input**
- One or more PAF files (optionally bgzipped). - A **target range** or a **BED file** of regions. - **Merge distance** (required). - **Sequence files** (required): source FASTA(s) for the aligned sequences.
**Output**
- A tabular matrix with one row per pair: `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `group.a`, `group.b`, lengths, intersection, and `jaccard`/`cosine`/`dice` similarity plus `estimated.identity` (or the corresponding distances when **Output distances** is set). - With **PCA/MDS**: a tabular table of `group`, `PC.rank`, `PC.value`.
